clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Ashenvale, Felfire Hill remains a blighted rise crawling with demons. Infernals struck it during the Third War, and its soil still burns with fel power. Horde guards hold the bridges leading to the hill, near their settlements.

During the Third War, the Burning Legion sent flaming meteors across Kalimdor, carrying its fearsome infernals. Several struck this ridge in Ashenvale, burning away the ancient woodland and corrupting the earth. The Legion fell at Mount Hyjal, but demons that survived its defeat still prowl the scorched slopes. Fel energy saturates the land they haunt.

Felfire Hill lies southeast of Splintertree Post and southwest of the Warsong Lumber Camp, close to vital Horde operations. Demonic remnants threaten to spill into the surrounding forest. Horde forces have raised fortified barricades and guard towers at both bridges leading to the hill, keeping the creatures within their blighted haven.
